using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using OpenRA;

namespace OpenRA.Game.Tests
{
	public class MapPreviewTests
	{
		// We will test the Install method's behavior around the HttpClient.GetAsync call.
		// Since HttpClientFactory.Create() is called inside the method and returns a new HttpClient,
		// and the call is non-virtual, we cannot mock HttpClient directly.
		// Instead, we test the observable effects of the Install method for different HttpClient responses.

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_DoesNotStartDownload_WhenStatusIsNotDownloadErrorOrDownloadAvailable()
		{
			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.Available);
			mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/maps/");
			// Since the status is not DownloadError or DownloadAvailable, no download should start.
			// We check that Status remains unchanged.
			Assert.NotEqual(MapStatus.Downloading, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsStatusToDownloadError_WhenMapInstallPackageNotFound()
		{
			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);
			// Remove the User classification from cache to simulate no install location
			mapPreview.ClearUserMapInstallLocation();

			mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/maps/");

			// Status should be DownloadError because no install location found
			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsStatusToDownloadError_WhenHttpResponseIsNotSuccess()
		{
			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);
			mapPreview.SetupHttpClientResponse(new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.NotFound));

			mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/maps/");

			// Wait a bit for the async Task.Run to complete
			await Task.Delay(100);

			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task Install_SetsStatusToDownloadError_WhenFilenameIsMissing()
		{
			var mapPreview = CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus.DownloadAvailable);
			var response = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.OK);
			response.Content.Headers.ContentDisposition = null; // No filename
			mapPreview.SetupHttpClientResponse(response);

			mapPreview.Install("http://example.com/maps/");

			await Task.Delay(100);

			Assert.Equal(MapStatus.DownloadError, mapPreview.Status);
		}

		// Helper methods to create a MapPreview instance with controlled state and HttpClient behavior.
		// These helpers rely on internal knowledge of MapPreview and may require reflection or partial mocks.
		// Since the code is not designed for easy injection of HttpClient, these tests are limited in scope.

		private MapPreview CreateMapPreviewWithStatus(MapStatus status)
		{
			// Create a MapPreview instance with minimal setup and set the innerData.Status to the given status.
			// We assume a constructor or factory method exists or use reflection to set private fields.
			// For this example, we simulate the creation and status setting.

			var mapPreview = (MapPreview)Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(MapPreview), nonPublic: true);
			var innerDataField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("innerData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var innerData = Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(MapPreview).GetNestedType("InnerData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic));
			innerData.GetType().GetField("Status").SetValue(innerData, status);
			innerDataField.SetValue(mapPreview, innerData);

			// Setup other required fields minimally to avoid null reference exceptions.
			// For example, cache, modData, etc. would be set similarly if needed.

			return mapPreview;
		}

		private void ClearUserMapInstallLocation(this MapPreview mapPreview)
		{
			// Clear the cache.MapLocations entry for User classification to simulate no install location.
			// This requires reflection to access private fields.
			var cacheField = typeof(MapPreview).GetField("cache", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var cache = cacheField.GetValue(mapPreview);
			var mapLocationsField = cache.GetType().GetField("MapLocations", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			var mapLocations = (System.Collections.IDictionary)mapLocationsField.GetValue(cache);
			mapLocations.Remove(MapClassification.User);
		}

		private void SetupHttpClientResponse(this MapPreview mapPreview, HttpResponseMessage response)
		{
			// Since HttpClientFactory.Create() is called inside Install and returns a new HttpClient,
			// we cannot inject a mock HttpClient easily.
			// This method is a placeholder to indicate where one would set up the HttpClient response if possible.
			// Without refactoring the production code, this is not feasible.
		}
	}
}
